# Good Landlord: code map

<!-- generated by APP_MAKER/standard/app_map.py · 2026-11-07 · code 460232d91c43 · regenerate after every change -->

**Read this first, then open only the files it points to.** Line numbers are where definitions start; read
around them with an offset instead of whole files.

**What it is:** Track rent, expenses, mortgage and long-term profit for your rentals, and give tenants a private, tamper-evident record of messages and repairs.
**Live:** https://good-landlord.anvil.app · **Repo:** github.com/arkulinskis/good-landlord · **Layout:** native Anvil Forms · **Deploy:** master
**Guide** (workflow, design rules, product knowledge): `good-landlord/.claude/skills/goodlandlord/SKILL.md`

## How to change it

- **New page**: copy a similar `client_code/Pages/<Name>/` (form_template.html + __init__.py), register it in
  `client_code/router.py` (`PAGES`, `_form()`, and `NAV` for the menu). Address = `#name/arg`.
- **New list**: a RepeatingPanel in the page template + `client_code/Items/<Name>/`. **Dialog**: `client_code/Dialogs/<Name>/` opened with `alert(...)`.
- **New server function**: `@anvil.server.callable` in the matching `server_code` module (see *Server*), called with `state.call("name", ...)`.
- **New table/column**: `anvil.yaml` → `db_schema` (the user accepts Anvil's Schema Mismatch alert); update the server-test mock.
- **Drawing/media/canvas**: a JavaScript engine in `theme/assets/` wrapped by a Python module or a `Components/` form.
- **Styles**: `theme/assets/app.css` (colour tokens at the top; rules in APP_MAKER/design/README.md).
- **Check**: `python tools/check.py` → ALL CHECKS PASSED; UI: `python -I tools/ui_test.py` (Docker Desktop running).
- **Deploy**: commit as arkulinskis (+ Co-Authored-By) and `git push` (master unless apps.json says branch-first).
- **Footer** must keep: Submit feedback (Prepsto), Privacy & Terms, Contact developer (arkvital.com), Parent company (addanapp.com).
- **After any change**: `python -I C:/Users/arkvi/Documents/CLAUDE/APP_MAKER/standard/app_map.py goodlandlord` refreshes this map.

## Notes

<!-- NOTES: hand-written, kept when the map is regenerated -->
- **Converted to native Forms on branch `forms` (2026-11-07)** from the JavaScript-pages version (old source folder
  `good-landlord`, web/pages/*.html + tools/deploy.py). Same server code, tables and `#addresses`.
- **The engine stays JavaScript**: `theme/assets/gl.js` = the old `_gl.html` script, maths unchanged (mortgage plans with
  Canadian semi-annual or US monthly compounding, balances, interest/principal splits, `GL.metrics`, `GL.verdict`,
  `GL.project`), the SVG houses (`GL.house`) and the two charts (`GL.lineChart`/`GL.barChart`). Its bottom part holds the
  view models for the Forms (`GL.metricsVM`, `dealVM`, `mortgageVM`, `renewVM`, `calcVM`, `taxInterestVM`,
  `renewalsVM`, `mortgagesVM`) that return plain numbers, and the `draw*` functions the Chart component calls.
- **`client_code/gl.py` is the bridge**: `gl.load()` calls `get_portfolio` (ONE call for every landlord page) and hands
  the reply to the engine with `GL.setData`; `gl.vm(name, ...)` / `gl.draw(name, el, ...)` call the engine with JSON
  (Python dicts go through `JSON.parse(json.dumps(...))`); `gl.money`, `gl.fmt_date`, `gl.ago` use the browser's locale
  like the old version. Lists, filters, the rent roll and "needs your attention" are Python.
- **Sealing/privacy is server-only and untouched**: `Record.append` writes every message and task move into a SHA-256
  hash chain (`messages.prev_hash/hash`), `Record.verify` checks it, and there is no callable that edits or deletes an
  entry (the server tests assert it). The tenant page (`#t/<token>`, Pages/TenantPage) only uses the public token
  callables (`tenant_view/post/request/confirm`); `TenantPortal._task` drops costs, and tenants never get the
  landlord's email or other properties. The client only displays the seal (`_seal` in Tenancy and TenantPage).
- **Shell on the tenant page**: `Shell.refresh("t")` hides the app header and tab bar (the page draws its own top bar);
  the footer with its four links stays.
- **Timers**: Tenancy and TenantPage poll every 30 s with `window.setInterval`; `router.show()` calls `leave()` on the
  page being left to stop it, and keeps a typed draft when it redraws. `after_open()` (router) does
  `#tenancy/<id>/share` (opens the link dialog) and `#deal/<id>/mortgage` (scrolls to the mortgage).
- **Dates in dialogs** are TextBoxes switched to `type="date"` (state.set_control_attr), so the server still gets
  'YYYY-MM-DD' strings exactly as before; numbers are typed text (C.num on the server parses "$1,200").
- **Browser storage keys kept** (prefix `goodlandlord.`): `money.prop` (ledger filter), `calc` (calculator), `tname.<token>`
  (the tenant's "Writing as" name), `theme`.
- **Facelift decisions**: eyebrow labels folded into the headings/leads (landing lead, home date line, property and
  tenancy sub-lines); the landing's radial glow and the sun/moon glow shadows removed; `--c-faint`, `--c-good`,
  `--c-sage` darkened to reach 4.5:1; uppercase letter-spaced mini headings (thread days, board columns, ledger months)
  made sentence case; hover movement gated to fine pointers; `.ui-stack` uses gap (Anvil wraps named parts in
  display:contents tags, so sibling margins didn't apply). Cream background and Fraunces are the user's choice (design-ok).
- Tests: `tools/ui/smoke.js` (every address signed out / as a landlord with the sample / as admin, plus the main
  dialogs, desktop + phone). The old flow tests weren't ported (the user runs the full tests on the branch link).
<!-- /NOTES -->

## Tools

- `tools/assets.py`: Refresh the theme assets' cache-busting hashes in anvil.yaml (and icons.css).
- `tools/build_icons.py`: Write theme/assets/icons.css from the icon table in theme/assets/lh-kit.js (UI.ICONS).
- `tools/check.py`: Everything that must pass before pushing. Ends with ALL CHECKS PASSED.
- `tools/make_icons.py`: Make the PNG app icons from theme/assets/icon.svg (headless Chrome draws them).
- `tools/ui_test.py`: Run the app for real in the open-source Anvil App Server (Docker) and drive it with headless Chrome.
